labels.shortDescription: Module Manager: the module is not installed or cannot be switched
labels.value: That module is not installed here, or it cannot be turned on and off. Click Check again to refresh the list.

labels.shortDescription: Module Manager: a turn on or off failed
labels.value: The module could not be switched. Nothing was changed. Try again, and if it fails again, check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Module Manager: the list or report could not be read
labels.value: The module list could not be read. Reload the page, and if it fails again, check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Module Manager: the admin permission set could not be given
labels.value: The module is on, but its administrator access could not be given to you. Give it on the Access page or in Setup.
